shape.situation_pattern: The world recoils at a claim that a model is 'thinking'; a frontier/cheap divide must justify spend.
shape.decision: Only gate to frontier when the cheap tier was provably insufficient; record the A/B verdict and the hidden 'dot' each time.
shape.reasoning_physics: Assumptions get A/B tested, not trusted; design needs high tier, execution is fine on low. The insight behind a right choice is worth a record.
